name: Flabbernaster Filingree, the First Mate
desc: Flabbernaster Filingree, the First Mate is a Gremor NPC who was part of [Cap'n Orlandeau's](entity:capn_orlandeau) crew in [The Scoundrel's Bounty](location:the_scoundrels_bounty), being his first mate. Appears to be well-versed in combat, considering how she had supposedly devastated the player in a sparring match the day before the events of the game.
additional_info: -   Filingree's racial variant appears to be Cedar.
